categories.main_business_segments: Lukfook Holdings operates primarily in the sourcing, designing, wholesaling, trademark licensing, and retailing of gold, platinum, and gem-set jewellery products. The Group's reportable segments include retailing in Hong Kong, Macau and overseas, retailing in Mainland China, wholesaling in Hong Kong and Mainland, and licensing business. Retailing is the main revenue source, accounting for over 80% of total revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes exquisite craftsmanship and innovative jewellery design, including CNC radiant colour finishing, 360-degree filigree, precision laser cutting, and traditional gold crafting techniques such as antique gold, mother-of-pearl inlay, and gilt-colouring. It also employs advanced product and inventory management, big data analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to enhance operational efficiency and product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves a diverse customer base across mass luxury, affordable luxury, and high-end segments. Key markets include Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Southeast Asia, North America, and Australia. The Group targets young consumers globally through its affordable luxury lines and also caters to premium customers with high-end brands and personalized services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Lukfook Holdings has a global footprint spanning 11 countries and regions, including Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Malaysia, Cambodia, the Philippines, Laos, Thailand, the United States, Canada, and Australia. The Group plans to expand into at least three more countries and increase overseas shops by 50 within three years.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates across multiple points in the supply chain, including upstream manufacturing and design, midstream wholesaling, and downstream retailing and licensing. It manages its own manufacturing facilities in Mainland China and controls retail operations through self-operated and licensed shops globally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include overseas market expansion, market-oriented product development focusing on both premium and affordable luxury segments, and operational efficiency enhancement through supply chain optimization, automation, big data, and AI technologies. The Group also emphasizes product differentiation via brand storytelling, innovative design, customization, IP collaborations, and quality assurance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales in retail and wholesale channels, licensing income from trademark usage, and consultancy services. The retail segment contributes the majority of revenue, supplemented by wholesaling and licensing businesses. The Group also develops e-commerce platforms to boost online sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lukfook Holdings faces strong competition from national and local jewellery and watch industry players. It positions itself as a leading multi-brand jewellery group with a strong presence in mass luxury, affordable luxury, and high-end markets. The Group leverages brand strategies, product innovation, and extensive distribution networks to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended March 2025, the Group reported revenue of HK$13.34 billion, a 12.9% decline year-on-year, and profit attributable to equity holders of HK$1.1 billion, down 37.8%. The Group operates 3,287 shops globally, with a net decrease of 296 shops. Despite short-term challenges, the Group maintains a strong financial base with plans for steady growth through expansion and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes quality craftsmanship, innovative and stylish designs, and a diversified multi-brand strategy to meet varied consumer needs. It offers unique value through personalized customization, integration of traditional and modern jewellery techniques, strong brand storytelling, and superior customer service. The Group also ensures quality assurance through in-house gemological laboratories and internationally accredited certification services.
